routeHint: Signed in as the ordinary member Adrian Whitfield (adrian.whitfield.209246@example.org, no permissions), open the Communications Committee thread 8947 'Refreshing the member newsletter: what should stay and what should go?' started by Iris Vargas (209201, no permissions, so blockable) and click the three-dot button at the top right of the post. The menu holds Report, Block user and Copy discussion link. Block user is only in the menu when the post owner is neither the viewer nor block protected, so a thread started by an HR_LOCAL or admin member (for example anything by Nora Vargas 209197) shows a two-item menu instead and is the wrong subject. 2026-11-11 recapture: the demo data was regenerated. Thread 8947 is now titled "How do I update my profile photo?" (the old title was Refreshing the member newsletter) and the route bounced to / because Adrian Whitfield (209246) was no longer a member of Communications Committee (unit 15670), so the discussion was invisible to him. Seeded: INSERT INTO user_unit_role_group (user_id, unit_id) VALUES (209246, 15670); then cache:pool:clear cache.short in orgo-1-php (groups are cached 5 minutes). Selector unchanged and still resolves. CORRECTION to the line above: the seed that works is a user_unit_role_group row (sidebar and visibility) plus a user_role row (member of a joinable group, which the Discussions tab and the group page gate need): INSERT INTO user_role (role_id,user_id,unit_id,date_created) VALUES (2847,209246,15670,"2026-02-11"); and INSERT INTO user_unit_role_group (user_id,unit_id) VALUES (209246,15670).
alt: Open three-dot menu on a discussion post by Iris Vargas in the Communications Committee, listing Report, Block user and Copy discussion link
note: The post three-dot button is the only ellipsis-vertical icon on the page for an ordinary member, so [data-icon="ellipsis-vertical"] with the runner's .first() resolves to it. waitFor uses Copy discussion link rather than Block user because it is the last item and only exists once the menu is painted.

routeHint: The comment three-dot menu is NOT rendered for an ordinary member. CommentItem.vue:54 gates the whole dropdown on `comment.owner.id === user.id || isModerator || canAdministerDiscussion`, so Block user on a comment is only reachable by the comment's own author, a moderator, or someone who can administer the discussion. This shot therefore uses the ADMIN_TENANT session on the organization-feed thread 8957 'Collaboration opportunities' (unit NULL, so isModerator resolves through COMMUNICATION_TENANT). The first comment is by Oliver Whitfield (209220, FINANCIAL_LOCAL, which ranks below HR_LOCAL and is blockable), which is why Block user appears beside the moderator actions. Pick a different thread and the first comment may be by an HR_LOCAL member, whose menu stops at Report. Checked 2026-11-11: the actions resolve and the comment menu opens on Delete, Moderate, Report, Block user and Copy discussion link.
alt: Open three-dot menu on a comment by Oliver Whitfield inside a discussion, listing Remove, Moderate, Report and Block user
note: Comment menu buttons carry .button.is-small.is-white.p-2 while the post menu button is .button.is-white.is-rounded, so this selector skips the post menu and the runner's .first() lands on the first comment. The scroll is required: without it the first comment sits at the bottom edge and the menu opens downwards off-frame, so the capture showed only Remove and Moderate. Remove and Moderate are in frame because the session holds moderation rights, which is the only way this menu renders at all.

routeHint: Same thread and account as block-post-menu: open the post three-dot menu, then choose Block user. Capture stops here: confirming is what creates the block, and the block for the feed and settings shots is made separately so this spec can be re-run without writing anything. 2026-11-11 recapture: same fix as block-post-menu (Adrian re-added to unit 15670, thread 8947 retitled). No selector change.
waitFor: text=You will no longer see posts and comments written by this member.
alt: Confirmation dialog titled Block user reading You will no longer see posts and comments written by this member, with Cancel and a red Block user button

routeHint: Own profile -> Settings & Privacy -> Blocked users. The route is /users/edit/{id}; 209246 is Adrian Whitfield, the capture account itself, because the Blocked users button is rendered only when item.id === user.id, so this panel does not exist on anybody else's profile, not even for an administrator. Do NOT rely on the ?setting=blockedUsers deep link alone: it sets openedSettings and pre-loads /user_blocks, but the settings pills live inside the Settings & Privacy tab and the page still opens on Profile, so the capture came out as the name and date-of-birth form. Both clicks are required. Requires at least one live block, otherwise the panel reads 'You have not blocked anyone.' 2026-11-11 recapture: the profile was rebuilt. /users/edit/209246 redirects to /user/209246?tab=edit&section=info and there is no Settings & Privacy tab. The page is now /user/209246?tab=settings (header Settings button), left pills Notifications, Privacy, Account and security; the Blocked users card sits on Account and security between Password and Close account. The old two-click Blocked users pill selector is gone. A live block is required and was seeded with SQL after capturing block-feed-before: INSERT INTO user_block (date_created,blocker_id,blocked_id,tenant_id) VALUES (now(),209246,209201,282); then cache:pool:clear cache.short cache.app. Delete that row to restore the before state.
alt: Blocked users card on the Account and security tab of a member's own profile settings, reading You do not see posts or comments written by these members, with a table listing Iris Vargas, the date she was blocked, and an Unblock button
note: User/Update.vue renders the Blocked users pill twice, once per layout branch, and only one of the two is visible. A bare 'click text=Blocked users' resolves to the hidden copy through the runner's .first() and times out, leaving a screenshot of the Profile tab, so the selector pins :visible. waitFor is the blocked member's name so the shot cannot fire on an empty panel.
